title: Switched from manual to automated trading after blowing an account — sharing how it's going
author: stan4848
selftext:
If you've ever blown an account because of revenge trading, overleveraging after a loss, or just not sticking to your own rules — you're not alone. That's part of why I moved to a rule-based automated approach instead.

Currency system has done 38% over a 20 trading day stretch. (Not claiming anything just stats)

Runs 24/5, no manual intervention, no emotional decisions, fixed position sizing, no martingale. Honestly still surprises me how much removing emotion from execution changes the outcome.

**Example trade: CADCHF swing capture**  
Entry near local support, exit near resistance — no guesswork, just the system following its rules. Two trades captured within the same uptrend: buy the dip, sell into strength, repeat.

Curious what this community thinks of the approach, happy to discuss the logic or risk management in the comments.
